facts.fact: REPLACES the earlier F212. Muthu's mother is alive and writes to him once a month, on the ninth-day post. Devan knows Muthu goes quiet when he lies (since the kalari pit as boys), so two grey-wax letters in two days, the first on an off post day, make him suspect Muthu is Ittan's man. He decides to keep Muthu close and frames the sealing-day gate post as an honour: Muthu will open the Keeper's boxes himself.
Kettamala's garrison is about sixty soldiers.

Devan moves Raiu from the head of the stair to the warden's chamber door; he is to be at the stair after dusk with a second man, and Devan doubles the watch. The carved bird is found cold on Neela's pillow, so Vellan placed it by day while she was away, and Neela reasons he means four nights, not five.
